errors.evidence: The sectors in the pie chart are arranged in descending order of size, as stated in the reference description, but the machine-generated description incorrectly claims they are arranged randomly.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the percentages are written inside the corresponding sectors, which is a notable visual feature.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the legend is color-coded and matches the sectors in the pie chart.
